svg.title: The parts of EquityLens I own: Dashboard (TWR XIRR via Newton's method): The flagship page: returns against a blended benchmark, a 0–10 health score and what-if rebalancing.; Unusual moves (λ = 0.94 |z| >= 3): EWMA volatility scores each day's log return against the holding's own recent volatility.; Event study (OLS β CAR ± 1.96σ): A market model splits each move into a market part and a company part, with a cumulative abnormal return band.; News pipeline (BM25 0.5 date 0.3 entity 0.2): Stored once in Postgres, ranked by a hand-written BM25 index, date proximity and entity match; refreshed nightly.; Guest mode (no sign-up data wiped on exit): Visitors try the whole product without an account, plus the landing page that sells it.
